نفتدي (form VIII)
# نَفْتَدِي (naftadī) /naf.ta.diː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَدَى (iftadā)
# نَفْتَدِيَ (naftadiya) /naf.ta.di.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِفْتَدَى (iftadā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
